grouped-memcpy.predication: Bulk copy only when all original per-state commit flags are true; otherwise original copies and dirty marks.

bank-copy.invariant: Initialize staged banks from current banks in root reset/load settling. For these single-edge flops, every uncommitted field must have staged == current before the barrier. Checked variant traps on a violation.

bank-copy-checked.invariant: Initialize staged banks from current banks in root reset/load settling. For these single-edge flops, every uncommitted field must have staged == current before the barrier. Checked variant traps on a violation.

bank-packed-flags.flag_representation: Satsuma little-endian, one-byte bool; full-byte masks, bounded memcpy loads.
